results.title: Guinea expels more than 1,500 illegal gold miners from West Africa | Lianhe Zaobao
results.snippet:
Guinea has stepped up its crackdown on illegal gold mining, expelling 1,557 West African nationals this week who had been arrested and convicted of the offence, sources said.
